sub: Pick the task first. Then the tool.
intro: Here are the 3 questions I ask before anyone buys an AI tool.

steps.title: Which task eats the most hours in your week?
steps.text: If you're not sure, write down where your hours go for one week.

steps.title: What does done look like for that task?
What do you already pay for that could do it?
steps.text: Check ChatGPT, Claude, your CRM, and Google or Microsoft before you buy anything new.

closing: Pick the task first. Then the tool.
